### What is changed and how it works?

### Check List

Tests <!-- At least one of them must be included. -->

- [ ] Manual test (add detailed scripts or steps below)

  > <!-- Or your custom  "No need to test" reasons -->

- [ ] Performance regression: Consumes more Memory

Documentation

- [ ] Contains variable changes
- [ ] Contains experimental features
- [ ] Changes MySQL compatibility

issue_context.title: Random triggering DumpStatsDeltaToKV reduces the impact of herd effect.
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement

Random triggering DumpStatsDeltaToKV reduces the impact of herd effect. Because in the tidb cluster, it is possible for tidb to trigger the DumpStatsDeltaToKV at the same time.

review_comments: Add some comment for the random value
